analytics.question: What were total refunds in Mumbai last month?
analytics.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.amount_paise), 0) AS refunds FROM refunds AS r JOIN invoices AS i ON r.invoice_id = i.id JOIN customers AS c ON i.customer_id = c.id WHERE c.city = 'Mumbai' AND r.refunded_on >= '2026-10-01' AND r.refunded_on <= '2026-10-31' LIMIT 100

analytics.question: Show me revenue by city
analytics.sql: WITH pay AS (SELECT c.city AS city, COALESCE(SUM(p.amount_paise), 0) AS total FROM payments AS p JOIN invoices AS i ON p.invoice_id = i.id JOIN customers AS c ON i.customer_id = c.id WHERE 1 = 1 GROUP BY c.city), ref AS (SELECT c.city AS city, COALESCE(SUM(r.amount_paise), 0) AS total FROM refunds AS r JOIN invoices AS i ON r.invoice_id = i.id JOIN customers AS c ON i.customer_id = c.id WHERE 1 = 1 GROUP BY c.city), cities AS (SELECT DISTINCT city FROM customers) SELECT cities.city AS city, COALESCE(pay.total, 0) - COALESCE(ref.total, 0) AS revenue FROM cities LEFT JOIN pay ON pay.city = cities.city LEFT JOIN ref ON ref.city = cities.city ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 100

analytics.question: What is the average invoice value?
analytics.sql: SELECT AVG(i.amount_paise) AS avg_invoice_value FROM invoices AS i JOIN customers AS c ON i.customer_id = c.id WHERE 1 = 1 LIMIT 100

analytics.question: How many invoices were paid?
analytics.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM invoices AS i JOIN customers AS c ON i.customer_id = c.id WHERE i.status = 'paid' LIMIT 100

analytics.question: What is the refund rate?
analytics.sql: WITH pay AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.amount_paise), 0) AS total FROM payments AS p JOIN invoices AS i ON p.invoice_id = i.id JOIN customers AS c ON i.customer_id = c.id WHERE 1 = 1), ref AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.amount_paise), 0) AS total FROM refunds AS r JOIN invoices AS i ON r.invoice_id = i.id JOIN customers AS c ON i.customer_id = c.id WHERE 1 = 1) SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT total FROM pay) = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST((SELECT total FROM ref) AS REAL) / (SELECT total FROM pay) END AS refund_rate LIMIT 100

analytics.question: Show me total refunds by city
analytics.sql: SELECT c.city AS city, COALESCE(SUM(r.amount_paise), 0) AS refunds FROM refunds AS r JOIN invoices AS i ON r.invoice_id = i.id JOIN customers AS c ON i.customer_id = c.id WHERE 1 = 1 GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY refunds DESC LIMIT 100
